Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order Form questions: invoice remit + tax docs

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to confirm a few things before we sign the Order Form:

- Invoice remit: Do you invoice to Redwood Inc (US) or do you have a European entity we should remit to for EU spend? Our AR team needs the remit entity for the PO.
- Net terms: our standard is Net45 for new vendors — will Redwood accept Net45 for the initial term?
- Taxes: attached is our standard form and a request for your VAT/resale certificate. We also saw language about "withholding" in section 7.3 of the draft — Helix cannot accept withholding unless we get evidence for tax residency. Can you confirm?

I've attached the PO (Helix_PO_4321.pdf) and our standard procurement checklist that asks for vendor tax certs. Please loop in legal/finance at Redwood if you need to.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our procurement window closes end of week.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Finance Operations (Helix AI)
laura.chen@helix.ai
+1 415-555-0189

Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form questions: invoice remit + tax docs

Laura — thanks for the clear list and for sending the PO. Quick answers up front, then I’ll follow with next steps: 

- Invoice remit: For US billing we'd invoice Redwood Inc (San Francisco, EIN XX-XXXXXXX). For EU spend we can offer Redwood Europe Ltd (Dublin) on the Order Form if you need EU entity invoicing — that’s common for customers with EU procurement.
- Net terms: we typically support Net30 on self-serve/standard contracts, but for enterprise deals we can agree Net45 with a small commercial offset (we usually do a 2% price uplift or a short activation fee to cover the extended DSO). Open to discuss.
- Withholding/taxes: we require clarity on which entity will bear VAT/withholding. We can remove a unilateral withholding clause but need tax residency evidence if Helix requests withholding be deducted.

Looping in Kimberly (finance/legal) and Karthik (commercials) to propose exact Order Form wording and any necessary PO fields for Ariba. Kimberly — can you review Helix’s PO + tax cert and propose the minimal redlines so we can keep the signature window open? Karthik — if Net45 is required, can you confirm the recommended commercial concession (uplift vs activation fee)?

Proposed next step: I’ll attach a version of the Order Form that includes the Redwood Europe billing option + two net terms options to expedite signatures — can you review and flag anything that needs legal redline? DocuSign link to follow once we agree the path.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni

Forwarding Helix's PO and tax doc — quick legal/finance notes inline below for the team.

On Mon, Jul 16, 2028 at 10:04 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com> wrote:
> Laura — thanks for the clear list and for sending the PO...

My notes (high level):
- Invoice remit: we can include Redwood Europe Ltd as billing entity on the Order Form. Need customer side legal name and VAT/Tax ID for billing if they choose EU remit. Add a short checkbox on the OF to indicate selected remit entity.
- Net terms: agree Net45 is acceptable commercially if we apply either: (a) 2% uplift across committed spend, or (b) one-time activation/processing fee equal to 2% of first invoice. Karthik — please confirm which option you prefer; option (b) preferred for smaller customers, (a) easier for finance to track at scale.
- Withholding: remove broad withholding right from the MSA/OF; instead require written tax-residency evidence prior to any withholding set-off. That protects revenue recognition.

I made tracked changes to the Order Form and attached a redlines doc (redlines_orderform_v2.docx). I kept the changes minimal: added fields for billing entity selection, net term selector, and a tax-evidence checkbox. If Helix needs legal language for reverse-charge/VAT, we can add a short exhibit.

I'll attach the redline and the clean PDF of the proposed OF for Vivek to send.

Kimberly Park
Head of Finance Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

Thanks Vivek & Kimberly — helpful. A few clarifications from procurement/AR: 

- We will provide Helix AI Netherlands BV (VAT NL123456789) as the remit for EU spend; confirm that the Order Form can show that exact legal entity name for invoicing.
- Net45: Helix cannot accept any price uplift for our standard Net45 terms; Net45 is non-negotiable for this account. If Redwood needs internal sign-off for Net45 without uplift, let us know what info you need.
- Withholding: we cannot provide tax-residency evidence for every region pre-signature; our legal here says we only provide certificates on request post-PO. If Redwood requires proof before allowing withholding exceptions, we may need a short alternative: state in the OF that "Helix will provide tax residency documentation within 30 days of invoice request".

We want to keep this moving; can you confirm you can accept Net45 clean (no uplift) and add Helix AI Netherlands BV as EU remit? If Redwood's finance absolutely needs a concession for Net45, please flag immediately so we can escalate.

—Laura

Laura — thanks for the quick response and for naming the EU remit entity. Two updates from our side and an ask: 

1) Commercials: Karthik has approved Net45 for Helix without uplift given the strategic nature of the pilot. No activation fee will be applied.

2) Invoice remit: we've updated the Order Form to include a "Bill to / Remit entity" selector so you can pick Redwood Inc (US) or Redwood Europe Ltd (Dublin) — we will add Helix AI Netherlands BV as the remit-to name on EU invoices when you select the EU option.

3) Withholding/tax evidence: Kimberly proposed language to avoid revenue risk while being practical: instead of requiring pre-signature evidence, we added a 30-day delivery window on tax residency docs and a mutual escalation path if AR withholds. Wording: "Customer may withhold taxes if required by law; Customer shall provide valid tax residency documentation within 30 days of withholding. Parties shall use reasonable efforts to agree any refund or gross-up necessary for withholding adjustments."

Attached: proposed_orderform_redwood_v3.pdf (clean) and a DocuSign envelope. If that wording is acceptable, please sign and return and we'll route the initial invoice according to the remit selection. If Helix needs legal markups, Kimberly is happy to take a short redline pass.
